glossary: PE / put option
A bet that Nifty will fall. Buying one pays if it falls; selling one pays you upfront and costs you if it falls.
CE / call option
A bet that Nifty will rise.
Lot
Nifty options trade in lots of 65 units. ₹1 of option price = ₹65 per lot.
Put spread
Sell one put, buy a cheaper one below it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
15-min candle close
Wait for the 15-minute bar on the chart to finish before acting, so one spike doesn't fool you.
Call spread
Sell one call, buy a cheaper one above it. You collect money, and your loss is capped.
Iron condor
A call spread and a put spread sold together. You collect both premiums; it pays if Nifty stays between the two sold strikes, and the loss is capped.

calls.result: Wrong: the 62,850 stop broke; Bank Nifty fell 754 pts (63,363 → 62,609) and printed 62,546; the lean down was right but the 63,600–63,750 bounce never came and a dip buy at 62,950–63,100 would have been stopped

calls.call: Last 15 minutes of monthly expiry: settle between 62,500 and 62,800, near 62,600; no new trades today, sell a Tuesday bounce to 63,000–63,150
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty broke the 62,850 floor and reads 62,609; big traders placed 546,000 new bets today that it won't rise against 172,000 that it won't fall
calls.result: Right: Bank Nifty settled 62,585, 15 points from the 62,600 pin and inside the 62,500–62,800 box; −24 pts (62,609 → 62,585), no trade was asked for

calls.call: Tuesday: stay between 62,000 and 63,300, leaning down; sell a bounce to 63,000–63,200, buy only a dip that holds 62,000
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty fell 2,050 points to 62,585 and settled near the day's low; for December big traders hold 44,000 bets that it stays under 66,000 and placed 28,500 new bets today that it won't rise against 18,800 that it won't fall
calls.result: Wrong: Bank Nifty gapped open at 63,408, through the 63,300 ceiling and the 63,400 stop before any trade; +823 pts (62,585 → 63,408); the sell-the-bounce plan never got a bounce to sell

calls.call: Rest of Wednesday: stay between 63,000 and 64,000, no lean; buy a dip to 63,100–63,250 that holds 63,100, sell only a stall at 63,900–64,000
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty jumped 823 points at the open to 63,408, above every level where big traders had bet it would stay under; 17,500 bets say it won't fall below 63,000 and 18,500 say it won't rise above 64,000
calls.result: Wrong: the 64,000 ceiling gave way on the second test, Bank Nifty reads 64,021 (high 64,040); the stall short from 63,950 gained 290 then reversed to a loss without reaching 63,500, and the 63,100–63,250 dip never came; +613 pts (63,408 → 64,021)

calls.call: Rest of Wednesday: stay between 63,500 and 65,000, leaning up; buy a dip to 63,900–64,000 that holds 63,900, sell only a stall at 64,900–65,000
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty broke above 64,000 on the second try and reads 64,021, up 1,436 on the day; today big traders placed 29,000 new bets that it won't fall against 19,000 that it won't rise, and bets that it stays under 65,000 are being withdrawn
calls.result: Wrong: the 63,450 stop was hit; Bank Nifty reversed 840 points from the 64,134 high to 63,294 within the hour, and the 63,900–64,000 dip never gave a 15-min close above 63,900; −727 pts (64,021 → 63,294)

calls.call: Rest of Wednesday: stay between 62,800 and 64,000, leaning down; sell a bounce to 63,800–64,000 that fails at 64,000, buy only a dip that holds 63,000
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty fell 840 points in an hour from 64,134 to 63,294 and sits on the day's low; big traders' bet that it stays under 64,000 held, 23,400 contracts strong, and the nearest bet that it won't fall is 19,600 contracts at 63,000
calls.result: Wrong: the lean down never paid; Bank Nifty rose 652 points from 63,294 to 63,946 and pierced the 64,000 ceiling (high 64,105), though no 15-min close above the 64,150 stop; the short from the 63,850–64,000 bounce gained 400 to the 63,471 low, then went flat, and the 63,400 target was never reached; +652 pts (63,294 → 63,946)

calls.call: Rest of Thursday: stay between 63,500 and 64,500, no lean; buy a dip to 63,600–63,700 that holds 63,450, sell only a stall at 64,100–64,200 that fails to close above 64,200
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty bounced from 63,471 to 64,105 and sits at 63,946, its third try at the 64,000 line in two days; since the open big traders placed 19,300 new bets that it won't fall against 8,000 that it won't rise, and 4,600 of those say it won't fall below 64,000
calls.result: Wrong: the 63,450 stop was hit; Bank Nifty fell 553 points from 63,946 to 63,393 (low 63,332), through the 63,600–63,700 buy zone without a 15-min close back above 63,700, and the 64,100–64,200 stall never came; −553 pts (63,946 → 63,393)

calls.call: Rest of Thursday: stay between 63,000 and 64,000, leaning down while 63,700 caps; sell a bounce to 63,600–63,700 that fails to close above 63,700, buy only a dip to 63,000–63,100 that closes back above 63,100
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty fell 378 points from 63,771 through the 63,450 floor to 63,393; big traders placed 5,900 new bets today that it stays under 64,000, the biggest pile on the chain, and started pulling their bets that it won't fall below 64,000
calls.result: Wrong: the lean down never paid; Bank Nifty bounced 194 points from 63,393 to 63,587 and reached the 63,600–63,700 sell zone only at 15:15, so the 63,100 target was never near; the 63,800 stop was not hit; −194 pts (63,393 → 63,587)

calls.call: Into the close and Friday: stay between 63,000 and 64,000, no lean; sell a bounce to 63,900–64,000 that fails to close above 64,000, buy only a dip to 63,100–63,300 that closes back above 63,300
calls.trigger: Bank Nifty bounced 194 points from 63,393 to 63,587; big traders placed about 4,700 bets each way at 64,000 today, that it won't rise and that it won't fall, and those who were buying protection near 63,500 have switched to selling it
